# Nutrient Document Processing

Curated by Skill Harbor: a document-operations skill built on the Nutrient DWS Processor API. It covers converting between PDF, DOCX, XLSX, PPTX, HTML, and images (20+ input formats), extracting text and tables, OCR in 100+ languages, pattern- and regex-based redaction (presets for social security numbers, emails, credit cards, phone numbers), watermarks, CMS digital signatures, and programmatic PDF form filling, with copy-paste curl recipes for every operation plus an MCP server configuration for native tool use. By @affaan-m, listed here with credit to its creator. From the affaan-m/ECC repository (MIT). Honest caveats: Nutrient is a commercial API, review their terms and pricing before use (the key is free to start); documents you process are sent to Nutrient's servers. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
